2. **Suspicious Link/URL:** The provided link, 'https://secure-dbs-verify-login.com', is not the official website for DBS Bank. 3. **Request for Immediate Account Verification:** The demand to 'Verify your account immediately' through an unsolicited link is a typical request from scammers seeking to obtain your online banking usernames, passwords, or One-Time Passwords (OTPs) (KNOWLEDGE RESULT 5: 'Log in to a banking account using a provided link' and 'Reveal online banking usernames and passwords').
